sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, random
line_pat = open('/app/regex.txt').read().strip()
ip = r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])){3}(?![A-Za-z0-9])'
date = r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])[0-9]{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-9]))(?![A-Za-z0-9])'
ip_re = re.compile(ip); date_re = re.compile(date)
def expected(text):
    out=[]
    for line in text.split('\n'):
        if ip_re.search(line):
            ds=date_re.findall(line)
            if ds: out.append(ds[-1])
    return out
toks = ['2024-01-01','2025-02-29','2024-04-31','2024-13-01','1134-12-1234','2024-01-01x','x2024-01-01','2024-01-01_',
        '1.2.3.4','255.255.255.255','256.1.1.1','01.2.3.4','1.2.3.04','1.2.3.4.5','x1.2.3.4','1.2.3.4x','1.2.3.4_',
        'foo','bar','-','_','.',',',' ','2024-12-31','0.0.0.0','1.2.3.456','999.1.1.1','199.200.249.250']
random.seed(0)
for n in range(20000):
    parts=[random.choice(toks) for _ in range(random.randint(1,8))]
    # avoid accidental plain separators only? join with random separators
    sep=random.choice([' ','','-','_','.',',','  '])
    text=sep.join(parts)
    got=re.findall(line_pat,text,re.MULTILINE)
    exp=expected(text)
    if got!=exp:
        print('MISMATCH',repr(text),got,exp)
        break
else:
    print('all ok')
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, calendar
p = open('/app/regex.txt').read().strip()
# Make a date-only version by stripping line prefix; easier: put date on a line with an IP.
dpat = r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])[0-9]{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-9]))(?![A-Za-z0-9])'
r=re.compile(dpat)
bad=[]
for m in range(1,13):
    maxd = 29 if m==2 else calendar.monthrange(2023,m)[1]
    for d in range(1,32):
        s=f'2023-{m:02d}-{d:02d}'
        got = bool(r.fullmatch(s))
        exp = d<=maxd
        if got!=exp: bad.append((s,got,exp))
print('date validity mismatches:', bad[:20], 'count', len(bad))
PY
EOF
